value.rationale: The 2026 source explicitly identifies change of generators as a future research direction; this self-contained natural enlargement by two shortest idempotent loops is the first nontrivial test instance. It fully resolves three canonical Green geodesic languages for that new metric, records a shift in shortest class lengths and a systematic jump to exactly 2/4 representatives, and proves their complexity survives the changed generators. The computation is for an infinite family of classes, not arbitrary tiny cases or a standard-alphabet re-enumeration.
